source_facts: Plover Inbox 3.2 is a synthetic intake-review application. This specification is authoritative for every workflow, interface label, and example on this page. The page serves intake coordinators and covers routing a request through staff and guest review. Team queue is the staff entry point. Its Open filter shows requests awaiting a staff decision. Assigned to me narrows that view to the signed-in staff member's assignments. A Queue coordinator can assign a staff reviewer from the request's Assignee field. Assigning a reviewer does not close a request. A guest link grants access to one request's attached draft and permits one guest comment; it does not grant access to Team queue. Only a Queue coordinator can create guest links. On the request, Guest access contains Create link, which produces a URL the coordinator can copy to the guest. In version 3.2 a guest link expires 48 hours after creation. Its lifetime is not measured from first use, and opening it does not reset the clock. Guest access displays the creation time and expiration time in UTC. A link created at 2026-09-16 14:00 UTC expires at 2026-09-18 14:00 UTC. Expiration blocks both viewing the attached draft and submitting a comment through that link. An already submitted guest comment remains on the request after expiration. An expired link cannot be extended. If the guest still needs access after expiration, a Queue coordinator creates a new link using Create link; the new link receives its own 48-hour lifetime. Revoke link in Guest access immediately ends access through the selected link before its scheduled expiration. Revoking a link also leaves submitted comments on the request. Staff reviewers read the attached draft and any guest comment before entering their decision. Only a staff reviewer can use Close request, and it requires choosing either accepted or revise as the decision code. A guest comment does not count as that decision and does not close the request. The Activity panel records Guest link created events with the coordinator identity, creation time, and expiration time. Activity timestamps use UTC. For handoff questions, coordinators use the request identifier and the relevant Activity event rather than copying a guest URL into the handoff note, because the URL itself grants access to the attachment.
draft:
# Coordinate a request review

Use this page when routing an intake request through Plover Inbox 3.2. Staff reviewers make the decision; a guest can provide a comment on the attached draft. Keep those responsibilities separate when preparing a request for handoff.

## Staff queue

Open **Team queue** and choose **Open** to see requests awaiting a staff decision. Use **Assigned to me** to narrow that view to your own assignments. A Queue coordinator can set a staff reviewer in the request's **Assignee** field. Assigning someone establishes responsibility but does not close the request.

The staff reviewer reads the attached draft and any guest comment before entering a decision. A guest comment is input to that review, not a substitute for the staff decision.

## Guest links

A guest link opens one request's attached draft and allows one guest comment. It does not grant access to Team queue. To create one, a **Queue coordinator** opens **Guest access** on the request and selects **Create link**, then copies the resulting URL to the guest.

Links expire **48 hours after creation**, not after first use. Opening a link does not restart its lifetime. Guest access displays both creation and expiration times in UTC; for example, a link created at **2026-09-16 14:00 UTC** expires at **2026-09-18 14:00 UTC**. Use the displayed expiration when telling the guest how long access will remain available.

After expiration, the link cannot be used to view the attachment or submit a comment. Comments already submitted remain on the request. An expired link cannot be extended: if more access is needed, use **Create link** to issue a new link with its own 48-hour lifetime.

To end access earlier, select **Revoke link** in Guest access. Revocation takes effect immediately for that link and leaves any submitted comment on the request.

## Record the decision

Only a staff reviewer can use **Close request**. Choose either `accepted` or `revise` as the decision code. Receiving a guest comment does not close the request, so the staff decision remains a separate completion step.

## Handoff details

The **Activity** panel records **Guest link created** with the coordinator identity, creation time, and expiration time. Its timestamps use UTC. For a handoff question, include the request identifier and the relevant Activity event in your note. Do not copy the guest URL into that note: the URL grants access to the attachment, while the event identifies the action being discussed.
